annotations.title: Read a server's recent console output

description: Returns up to 200 recent console lines, including startup, oldest first. Use it to see why a server failed to start or what happened in game; it cannot run commands. Returns events, nextCursor (newer) and prevCursor (older); platform notices are left out, so a page can hold fewer lines, or none, while prevCursor still leads to older ones. degraded: true means the read timed out, retry. Show lines to the user in a code block, one per line.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

before.description: prevCursor from a previous call; overrides cursor.

name: getConsoleLogs
title: Read a server's recent console output
